init_config_eval_mode: initialize config args for evaluating a neural architecture on cifar10 or imagenet datasets
init_config_train_ghn_mode: initialize config args for training a GHN hypernetwork with adam optimizer and 300 epochs
init_config_train_net_mode: initialize config args for training a neural network like DARTS with sgd optimizer
init_config_multigpu_training: initialize config args with multigpu support for distributed training across available cuda devices
init_config_custom_kwargs: initialize config args with custom default values passed via kwargs for batch size or hidden units
